plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugins.Punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON
plugins.Description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugins.Changelog:
Man it's been a bit huh?
- Added notification master support for sending toast, flashing the icon, and bringing to foreground
- Fixed Mode Select to actually not have gold completion mode as a supported mode (this was never officially supported to being with)
- Changed the planet / job selection to "Auto View" so people stop thinking it changes jobs (it's still going to happen I know it...)
- Chat notifications for all stop when conditions SHOULD be there now (in case you want triggers for that / have it enabled)
- Settings has been given a cleanup, a lot of the misc ones have been compacted and given a search feature to quickly look them up while in the tab. 
   - Notification master settings are also here, default is off
- Added log information for when a change has been detected via recipe settings that is set in cosmic plugin (that way you can know if you actually changed something or not)
- Added a warning if you're msising collectables, AND WILL LET YOU NOW THAT YOU NEED TO GO UNLOCK THEM. (Same with aetherial reduction i believe. . . )
